# Niwala

> Niwala is an Android calorie counter and protein tracker for Indian, Pakistani and Bangladeshi food. It has 190+ desi dishes modelled from home recipes with USDA FoodData Central ingredient values, in real portions (roti, katori, plate), lets users set how much oil or ghee went in, logs meals from a photo with AI, understands Hinglish and Roman Urdu, and includes 16,000+ everyday foods and a free barcode scanner. Free, with an optional Premium subscription. No ads. Made by Waleed Waheed.

Calorie figures are modelled estimates for home-style cooking; a katori is about 150 g cooked. Restaurant versions are often higher because of extra oil, ghee or cream.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://waleed-waheed.github.io/niwala/): what Niwala does, FAQ
- [Calories in Indian and Pakistani food](https://waleed-waheed.github.io/niwala/calories/): all dishes with calories and protein per portion
- [Privacy policy](https://waleed-waheed.github.io/niwala/privacy.html)
